items.headline: Gale Watch issued October 16 at 2:36AM EDT until October 18 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 30 knots with gusts up to 40 knots and
seas 9 to 14 feet possible.

* WHERE...Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm
and Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 20-60 nm.

* WHEN...From Saturday afternoon through Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 16 at 2:36AM EDT until October 18 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 30 knots with gusts up to 35 knots
and seas 8 to 13 feet expected.

* WHERE...Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 0-20 nm and Sebastian
Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 20-60 nm.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Saturday to 8 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
